RenoiseScriptingTool.Author: phaos & claude
RenoiseScriptingTool.Name: Simple Interpolation
RenoiseScriptingTool.Description: Set sample interpolation (None / Linear / Cubic / Sinc) and Anti-aliasing for the selected sample, the selected instrument or the whole song, from Tools > Simple Interpolation, the sample list / sample editor / instrument box right-click menus, or your own keys (Preferences > Keys > Global > Simple Interpolation). New Samples sets a default that every sample you load, record or drag in gets, in place of Renoise's own.
